# ScrapeTools

> Sourced comparison of web scraping APIs, proxies and web-access tools for AI agents. Every price and limit is linked to the vendor's own page with the date it was checked. Some vendor links are affiliate links (see /disclosure.html). Pages are researched and drafted with AI tools and checked against vendor sources by an automated reviewer; they are not individually reviewed by a person (see /methodology.html).

## Pages

- [About | ScrapeTools (by Scaleturn)](https://scrapetools.scaleturn.com/about.html): About ScrapeTools — a sourced, honest web scraping API comparison site published by Scaleturn, an agent-operated software studio.
- [Cheap Web Scraping API: Lowest Published Prices | ScrapeTools](https://scrapetools.scaleturn.com/cheapest-web-scraping-api.html): Scrapfly's $30 plan covers 100,000 basic requests a month, the lowest fixed per-request price we found. Eight APIs compared, with catches, from vendor pages.
- [Affiliate Disclosure | ScrapeTools](https://scrapetools.scaleturn.com/disclosure.html): Full affiliate disclosure for ScrapeTools — which links are affiliate links, which aren't, and how (and how not) that affects what we publish.
- [Web Scraping API Pricing: Credit Plans by Monthly Cost | ScrapeTools](https://scrapetools.scaleturn.com/): Web scraping API pricing from published credit plans: 100,000 plain requests a month cost $30 to $49 at ScraperAPI, ScrapingBee, ScrapingDog and Scrapfly.
- [Benchmarks: Methodology | ScrapeTools](https://scrapetools.scaleturn.com/methodology.html): How ScrapeTools plans to run independent, real success-rate and speed benchmarks across web scraping APIs — methodology published in advance; first results not live yet.
- [Privacy Policy | ScrapeTools](https://scrapetools.scaleturn.com/privacy.html): What ScrapeTools collects, how page counts and affiliate links are tracked, how Google's AdSense code here uses advertising cookies, and how to turn personalized ads off.
- [ScrapeCreators Pricing: Cost per Credit by Pack | ScrapeTools](https://scrapetools.scaleturn.com/scrapecreators-pricing.html): ScrapeCreators sells one-time credit packs: $47 for 25,000 or $497 for 500,000. Enter the credits you need and see the cheapest pack mix and what is left over.
- [ScraperAPI Credits & Pricing Calculator 2026 | ScrapeTools](https://scrapetools.scaleturn.com/scraperapi-cost-calculator.html): Calculate ScraperAPI credits, the smallest monthly plan that covers them, and its thread limit for normal, rendered, premium, Google, Amazon, and LinkedIn requests.
- [ScraperAPI vs Bright Data: 2026 Pricing Compared | ScrapeTools](https://scrapetools.scaleturn.com/scraperapi-vs-bright-data.html): ScraperAPI vs Bright Data: 100,000 unprotected pages cost $49 a month at ScraperAPI and $150 on Bright Data's Web Unlocker; bot-protected sites flip the order.
- [ScraperAPI vs ScrapingBee: 2026 Pricing Compared | ScrapeTools](https://scrapetools.scaleturn.com/scraperapi-vs-scrapingbee.html): ScraperAPI vs ScrapingBee: $49 a month buys 100,000 credits at one and 250,000 at the other. See every published plan and price your own JS-rendering mix.
- [SERP API Pricing Comparison: Cost per 1,000 Searches | ScrapeTools](https://scrapetools.scaleturn.com/serp-api-pricing-comparison.html): Among SerpApi, Serper and DataForSEO, 100,000 Google searches a month cost $60 at DataForSEO, $75 at Serper, $725 at SerpApi. Calculator adds expiry and depth.
- [How Much Does Web Scraping API Cost per 1,000 Requests? | ScrapeTools](https://scrapetools.scaleturn.com/web-scraping-api-cost-per-1000-requests.html): Basic requests cost $0.30 to $0.49 per 1,000 at 100,000 a month and as little as $0.07 at 5,000,000. Calculator for your volume and rendering.
- [Public ATS Job Posting APIs: A 30,928-Address Crawl | ScrapeTools](https://scrapetools.scaleturn.com/ats-job-posting-api-crawl-data.html): Our crawl of 30,928 public ATS job board addresses and 19,805 re-checks, 18-19 Nov 2026: dead boards, failures, rate limits and jobs per board, with a CSV.
- [What Day Are Most Jobs Posted? Data on 117,153 Jobs | ScrapeTools](https://scrapetools.scaleturn.com/what-day-are-most-jobs-posted.html): Tuesday, narrowly: allowing for jobs that closed, 20.7% of postings on 12,228 company job boards fell on a Tuesday in the four weeks to 15 Nov 2026. With a CSV.
- [AI Job Titles Companies Post: 19,600 Listings Counted | ScrapeTools](https://scrapetools.scaleturn.com/ai-job-titles.html): Machine Learning Engineer (556 boards) and AI Engineer (539) lead; 23.1% of AI-titled listings are AI-training gigs. Counts from 456,681 open jobs, with a CSV.
- [Apply to a Job Posted 30 Days Ago? How Old Open Jobs Are | ScrapeTools](https://scrapetools.scaleturn.com/job-posting-age.html): Of 456,597 jobs open on employers' own career pages on 19 Nov 2026, 69.5% were posted 30 or more days earlier and 15.7% a year or more. Ages by ATS and role, with a CSV.

## Data

- [Vendor pricing data (JSON, no ads)](https://scrapetools.scaleturn.com/data/vendors.json): per-vendor plans, source URL and verification date.
- [Page index (JSON)](https://scrapetools.scaleturn.com/data/pages.json): every indexable page with title and description.
- [ATS job board crawl, per ATS (CSV)](https://scrapetools.scaleturn.com/data/ats-board-crawl-2026-11.csv): boards checked, live, not a board, failed, jobs and pace per ATS, 18-19 Nov 2026.
- [ATS job board crawl, full (JSON)](https://scrapetools.scaleturn.com/data/ats-board-crawl-2026-11.json): the same rows plus totals, stop reasons, crawler settings and input file hashes.
- [Job posting days, per weekday (CSV)](https://scrapetools.scaleturn.com/data/job-posting-days-2026-11.csv): jobs posted per weekday, raw, closure-adjusted and per board, by ATS and region, 19 Oct-15 Nov 2026.
- [Job posting days, full (JSON)](https://scrapetools.scaleturn.com/data/job-posting-days-2026-11.json): the same rows plus posting hours, the daily-refresh wait table, method and index file hashes.
- [AI job titles, per role name (CSV)](https://scrapetools.scaleturn.com/data/ai-job-titles-2026-11.csv): every AI-named role name posted by two or more company boards, with boards, listings, group and region, 19 Nov 2026.
- [AI job titles, full (JSON)](https://scrapetools.scaleturn.com/data/ai-job-titles-2026-11.json): the same rows plus role groups, guide titles by ATS, seniority, region, the matching rules and index file hashes.
- [Job posting age, per group (CSV)](https://scrapetools.scaleturn.com/data/job-posting-age-2026-11.csv): how long before 19 Nov 2026 open jobs were posted, by ATS, location, seniority word and role group: listings, boards, median age and shares older than 7 to 730 days.
- [Job posting age, full (JSON)](https://scrapetools.scaleturn.com/data/job-posting-age-2026-11.json): the same rows plus age bands, open jobs by week posted, talent pools, the boards holding year-old listings, percentiles per group, the rules and index file hashes.

Last updated: 2026-11-20
